interface.name: afterstep_control_v1
interface.description: Minimal control interface for the AfterStep wlroots compositor scaffold. Used by Wayland clients in the AfterStep "suite" (panel, launchers, etc.) to request actions from the compositor process.

request.name: exec
request.description: Spawns COMMAND via /bin/sh -c in the compositor process.

request.name: quit
request.description: Requests that the compositor terminates its Wayland display.

request.name: close_focused
request.description: Requests that the compositor asks the focused client to close.

request.name: focus_next
request.description: Requests that the compositor changes keyboard focus to another view.

request.name: focus_prev
request.description: Requests that the compositor changes keyboard focus to another view.

request.name: set_workspace
request.description: Requests that the compositor switches to WORKSPACE (1-based).

request.name: workspace_next
request.description: Requests that the compositor switches to the next workspace.

request.name: workspace_prev
request.description: Requests that the compositor switches to the previous workspace.

request.name: list_windows
request.description: Requests that the compositor sends a window list snapshot via: window_list_begin, zero or more window events, then window_list_end.

request.name: focus_window
request.description: Requests that the compositor focuses the window. If the window is on a different workspace, the compositor may switch to it.

request.name: close_window
request.description: Requests that the compositor asks the target client to close.

request.name: move_window_to_workspace

description.summary: Move a window to a workspace

request.description: Moves the window to WORKSPACE (1-based). The compositor does not automatically switch workspaces.

request.name: toggle_fullscreen

description.summary: Toggle fullscreen for the focused view

request.description: Requests that the compositor toggles the focused client's fullscreen state.

request.name: toggle_maximized

description.summary: Toggle maximized for the focused view

request.description: Requests that the compositor toggles the focused client's maximized state.

event.name: workspace_state
event.description: Notifies clients of the current workspace (1-based) and total workspace count. Sent on bind and whenever the workspace changes.

event.name: window
event.description: Upsert-style window state notification. FLAGS is a bitmask: 1 = mapped 2 = focused 4 = xwayland 8 = minimized

event.name: window_closed
event.description: Sent when the window is destroyed and should be removed from clients' lists.

event.name: output_state
event.description: Notifies clients of the (single) output size in logical pixels. Sent on bind and whenever the output size changes. Used by pager-style clients to scale window rectangles.

event.name: window_geometry
event.description: Frame geometry for a window in output-local coordinates. Sent during window list snapshots, and may also be sent when windows move/resize.
